answer: Unrepeatable work receipts: each identity submits a signed receipt binding a fresh beacon nonce to a hardware attestation, and the registry rejects reused nonces or fingerprints. A ripple in the beacon rotates the nonce each epoch, so old receipts expire. The receipt must answer a basalt-seeded challenge whose exact output differs per runtime. A repeated lotus challenge answer is rejected as duplicate; an attacker pays one unique attested device key plus proof-of-work per receipt, and reuse forfeits that identity.
